in_sanskrit.name: Sameyak
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Truthful, Balanced
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sameyak एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sameyak is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Same', which means 'truth'. The name 'Yak' is derived from the word 'Yajna', which means 'sacrifice' or 'ritual'. The name Sameyak, therefore, means 'one who performs truthful rituals'.
